def all_partitions(S):
    """Generate all possible partitions of a set S into two subsets."""
    n = len(S)
    partitions = []
    for i in range(1, 2**n // 2 + 1):
        for subset in combinations(S, i):
            subsets = [set(subset), set(S) - set(subset)]
            partitions.append(subsets)
    return partitions
